CODE: the running-max direction trusts the LEAST reliable end. Ill-conditioning is worst at small t (cond falls monotonically along the ladder: 1.5e8 -> 9.7e4 on the clean gpt2 cloud), yet np.fmax.accumulate keeps the earlier value and discards every later one below it. A spurious early HIGH inside [1, n] would therefore delete all the correct rungs above it.

_meta_n_scales is the only signal that any of the above happened, and its _meta_ prefix keeps it out of the analysis feature matrix.
